subject: Meteorology
title: Types of Lightning
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Types of Lightning.

hook.text: Cloud-to-ground lightning gets the attention—but most lightning never reaches the surface at all.

buildup.text: Intra-cloud lightning is the most common type—discharges between positive and negative regions inside one cloud.

discovery.text: Cloud-to-cloud lightning jumps between separate clouds—sometimes visible as spectacular horizontal bolts.

twist.text: Positive cloud-to-ground lightning originates from the top of the storm—it's rarer but far more powerful and deadly.

climax.text: Sprites, jets, and elves are lightning above the storm—discharges into the upper atmosphere found in the 1990s.

punchline.text: Lightning goes up, down, and sideways—inside and above the clouds.

quiz.question: What is the most common type of lightning?
